messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync 3 locking GA gates. Two possible blockers: telemetry fidelity for regressions, and multi-currency/pricing display. Need to decide must-haves vs ship-as-flag.
Ravi Singh: Telemetry fidelity is a hard block. Without canonical events QA can't validate regressions.
Tessa Park: For pricing, propose display-only conversion + footnote for GA. Docs will include exact wording and support runbook.
Linh Nguyen: Legal: check if display-only conversions are acceptable (invoices remain USD) or if contract appendix needed.
Omar Reyes: SRE needs an alert matrix mapping events to page vs dashboard, otherwise oncall will be noisy/blind.
Priya (FinOps): If invoices are USD but UI shows local conversion, include dispute playbook and a contract note. I'll draft cost implications.
Maria Chen: Proposed PROD-ENTRY required: 1) telemetry event set + sample payloads + alert matrix; 2) EU privacy/terms translations; 3) docs page with pricing fallback + support playbook; 4) SLO->SLA mapping. Optional: full UI localization, native multi-currency billing.
Ravi Singh: I'll deliver telemetry schema + samples by Thu EOD.
Omar Reyes: I'll produce alert matrix + staging smoke checklist. Scheduling staging run Thu 09:00 UTC.
Tessa Park: I'll open docs PR with fallback wording + internal support steps.
Linh Nguyen: Legal/commercial will review contract appendix by Fri.
Priya (FinOps): I'll post cost numbers and recommend default: display-only conversion + invoice USD.
staging-bot: scheduled deploy redwood/console v3.2 -> staging @ 2026-03-14T09:00Z
Maria Chen: Timeline: signoff by Fri COB. Owners: Ravi (telemetry), Omar (alerts + smoke), Tessa (docs), Linh/Priya (legal/commercial). Escalate blockers to #release-war-room.
__note: Synthetic Slack thread generated for dataset. Short, realistic messages about GA gating, telemetry, and pricing fallbacks.
